title: Code on Wages private-beta source-readiness review decision
authorityBoundary: The deterministic rule executes before retrieval and provider output.
Complete and reported-gap inputs remain specialist-review.

Retrieval and provider output cannot create facts; choose the appropriate Government, rate, category, zone, scheduled employment or State instrument; perform arithmetic; determine an employee entitlement or remedy; or alter the deterministic result.
privacyBoundary: No employee identities, payroll, wage records, payslips, attendance, disputes, claims, notices, orders, individual entitlements or evidence bodies.

Only organisation-level source-route, source-readiness, commencement, version, jurisdiction-routing, bounded rate-register, State-instrument-register, escalation statuses and controlled references may be processed.
sourceBoundary: Wave 5A Code, Central Rules and jurisdiction source identities are reused; Wave 5C adds commencement, Rules-corrigendum and bounded notification-register identities.
The catalogue does not represent State/UT wage instruments, rate schedules, categories, zones or scheduled-employment mappings as selected or complete.
Exact controlled source-file acquisition and qualified legal/source-file review remain open.

approval.notes: Software implementation and tests do not constitute legal, privacy, RAG, source-file, security or release approval.
